svg.text: AI-Powered Energy Decision Framework — end to end
5 metros · 1,200 MW (60% fast charging, 40% swap) · 600 MWh storage · hourly decisions aligned to IEX
1 · DATA IN — 5 years hourly history + live feeds
3 · FORECAST LAYER (AI/ML) — every forecast is a range, not one number

g.text: Inputs: hour, day, festivals, heat index,
lags, fleet shifts, events, own tariff
Out: P10 / P50 / P90 per hub · hour ·
Weather at the plant, not the metro
Out: P10 / P50 / P90 MWh per

svg.text: Scenario engine — one weather story drives all three forecasts together
Gaussian copula on past errors → 200 joint paths (cloudy day = less solar + dearer evening) → 20 weighted scenarios
4 · DECISION ENGINE (OPTIMISATION) — one model decides P4, P5 and P6 together
Stage 1 · Day-ahead plan: two-stage stochastic MILP (Pyomo + HiGHS / Gurobi)
Maximise expected profit − battery wear − unserved-demand penalty − CVaR risk, over 20 scenarios

g.text: hold at 50–60% SoC, top up 60–90 min
split RE contracts, IEX budget and
5 price levels per hub · hour · segment

svg.text: Stage 2 · Hourly rolling re-plan (MPC): re-solve the next 24–48 h with fresh data
real-time market top-ups, battery dispatch, pack charging and moves, price nudges
5% capacity + packs locked · ±20% price band · grid caps · SoC / thermal limits · EBITDA ≥ 12% per cluster
5 · ACT — with a rule-based fallback if the cloud is down

g.text: P1–P6 = the six problems. MILP = mixed-integer linear program. CVaR = average loss on the worst 5% of days. SoC / SoH = battery state of charge / health.
ToD = DISCOM time-of-day tariff (MoP 2024 EV guidelines: 0.7× average cost of supply 09:00–16:00, 1.3× other hours). REMC = Renewable Energy Management Centre.
